photo.fileTitle: File:'Do not shoot' a group of students shout.JPG
photo.caption: A group of students raise their hands in the air to signal that they have come in peace, as part of the 2015–2016 student protests against university fee increases in South Africa.
photo.alt: A group of students raise their hands in the air to signal that they have come in peace. Student protest (2015-16) in South Africa against university fee increases.
